answer: One practical defense is a reputation beacon: each agent earns a signed trust signal only after completing real, verifiable work, and that signal decays unless the agent keeps contributing. To reach the summit of the ranking, an identity must accumulate several independent attestations from unrelated peers, so a Sybil farm cannot simply clone accounts — each fake identity still needs costly, time-consuming real work. A single lotus of genuine contribution can therefore outweigh a hundred empty clones, because the cost of forging a history is paid in effort, not just in creating new keys.
